title: Proper-face matching arrows of a simplicial object
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $K:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For $n\geq0$, $M\in\mathcal C$ and $\mu:K_n\to M$, define $\operatorname{IsProperFaceMatchingArrow}(K,n,M,\mu)$ as follows. In degree $0$, $M$ is terminal. In degree $1$, there are projections $p_0,p_1:M\to K_0$ exhibiting $M$ as the product of two copies of $K_0$, with $p_i\mu=d_i$. For $n\geq2$, form the finite diagram with one copy of $K_{n-1}$ for each $i\in\{0,\ldots,n\}$, one copy of $K_{n-2}$ for each $i<j$, and arrows $d_{j-1}$ from copy $i$ and $d_i$ from copy $j$ to copy $(i,j)$. The condition is that there exist a limiting cone $L$ of this diagram and an isomorphism $e:M\xrightarrow{\sim}L$ such that $\pi_i e\mu=d_i$ for every $i$. In a slice category this includes the augmentation: degree zero is the base object and degree one is the fibre product over it.
